skill_name: Explain how the genetic variability of each species can contribute to evolution.
workflow: Genetic variability is an important factor in evolution. Genetic variability occurs when individual members of a species differ in the alleles they possess. This variability can arise through mutation, the accumulation of random errors as genes are copied and passed on from one generation to the next.
